notes.title: Exciting Changes Ahead
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42785874/f65cc2c05d37e8b5dcf658ad5da1b739afdd1f85.png[/img]

Greetings, dear players!

We are thrilled to announce some major updates and exciting news about our game. First and foremost, we have changed the name of our game to [b]Greyskin[/b]. This new name aligns better with the serious and immersive tone our game has evolved into.

Along with the new name, we have also updated the key art of the game. We believe this new artwork represents the essence and atmosphere of Greyskin more accurately. We hope you all appreciate the change and feel it encapsulates the spirit of our game.

[h3][b]Progress and Upcoming Features[/b][/h3]
We are diligently working on numerous updates and enhancements:

[b][i]New Minibosses[/i][/b]: We are nearly finished with several new minibosses, adding more challenges and excitement to your journey. However, we still have a lot more to develop.
[b][i]Progression Systems and Upgrades[/i][/b]: Significant progress is being made on various progression systems, including skill trees and upgrades, ensuring a richer and more rewarding gameplay experience.
[b][i]Character Redesigns[/i][/b]: In line with the game’s evolving tone, we are redesigning all playable characters. The old designs, while endearing, were a bit too cute for the serious direction our game has taken. Our new designs are more fitting for the dark, immersive world of Greyskin.
[b][i]Loot Systems[/i][/b]: We are working on drop systems, loot tables, and other improvements to our loot mechanics to enhance your adventure.
[b][i]UI Refresh[/i][/b]: We are refreshing the overall UI in the game to be clearer and more user-friendly. This includes font changes, simplified color palettes, and other visual improvements.
[b][i]Future Localization and Achievements[/i][/b]: We are implementing systems to handle future localization and achievements, making the game more accessible and fun.
[b][i]Unique Items[/i][/b]: We are designing unique items and unique affixes to enhance overall gameplay and strategy.
[b][i]Endgame Content Planning[/i][/b]: Thinking ahead of what’s to come after our EA release.

[h3][b]Meet Us at Gamescom 2024[/b][/h3]
We are excited to announce that we will be attending Gamescom 2024 at the Indie Arena Booth! We warmly invite you to come by and say hi. It’s a fantastic opportunity for us to connect with you, and share more about Greyskin.

[h3][b]A Mysterious Presence[/b][/h3]
Our new key art features a mysterious creature known as Mother. She plays a pivotal role in the lore of our game and the creation of Greyskin. Her presence is felt throughout your journey, adding a layer of depth and mystery that we can’t wait for you to explore.

[h3][b]Thank You for Your Support[/b][/h3]
We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone for your continuous patience and support throughout our development journey. Rest assured, we are positive and hopeful that these changes are for the best. We believe these updates will resonate on a deeper level with the genre lovers.

Thank you once again for being part of our community. We are making steady progress towards our final goal, though we still have a long way to go :)

Best,
The Greyskin Devs
